strips.title: A new e-reader in its first month: in real life

panels.head: Before you buy
panels.text: Decide: text only, colour, or library books without a second device.

panels.head: Day one
panels.text: Check the listing for ads, then open the library or store you actually use.

panels.head: Week two
panels.text: Update prompts arrive. Owners say read the notes: some updates broke battery or books.

panels.head: Day 30
panels.text: Still inside the return window? Test the edges in dark mode and the battery now.
